cities.name: Sydney, Australia
cities.description: See the Sydney Opera House, stroll the harbour, and catch the golden light at Bondi Beach.

cities.name: Melbourne, Australia
cities.description: Explore a creative city known for its laneways, galleries, coffee culture, and leafy gardens.

cities.name: Tokyo, Japan
cities.description: Discover neon-lit streets, serene gardens, and a food scene that rewards every curious traveler.

cities.name: Kyoto, Japan
cities.description: Wander among historic temples, quiet gardens, and traditional wooden streets.

cities.name: Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
cities.description: Take in mountain-and-sea views, lively neighborhoods, and the famous sands of Copacabana.

cities.name: São Paulo, Brazil
cities.description: Experience Brazil's energetic cultural capital through its art, restaurants, and music.

temples.name: Angkor Wat, Cambodia
temples.description: Explore the vast temple complex of Angkor, a remarkable monument to Khmer art and history.

temples.name: Taj Mahal, India
temples.description: Admire the marble mausoleum and gardens of one of the world's most celebrated landmarks.

beaches.name: Bora Bora, French Polynesia
beaches.description: Swim in turquoise lagoons and take in the volcanic peaks rising above this island paradise.

beaches.name: Copacabana Beach, Brazil
beaches.description: Enjoy Rio's lively waterfront, broad sandy shore, and mountain views.
